confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Victoria Falls tourist pricing in USD (Zimbabwe's multi-currency economy makes local prices volatile). No live listings or booking pages were checked. Accommodation and bar prices are the least certain; restaurant anchors are somewhat firmer. The FX observation was taken from a search-reported copy of the RBA 15 October 2026 figure, not from a direct read of the RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on tourist-facing pricing in Livingstone, Zambia, the other Victoria Falls town across the border, adjusted to Zimbabwean USD pricing and a July peak-season window. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weak.
